dish.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Tofu Banh Mi with Pickled Carrot and Daikon
dish.description: Slabs of extra-firm tofu marinated in lemongrass, garlic, soy sauce, and sugar and seared golden, tucked into toasted baguettes with sriracha mayonnaise, quick-pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, jalapeno, and cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Tofu Banh Mi with Pickled Carrot and Daikon
recipe_version.description: Slabs of extra-firm tofu marinated in lemongrass, garlic, soy sauce, and sugar and seared golden, tucked into toasted baguettes with sriracha mayonnaise, quick-pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, jalapeno, and cilantro.

ingredients.name: baguettes
ingredients.display_name: 6-inch soft baguettes whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, and salt only

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.display_name: mayonnaise whose label lists oil, egg, vinegar, salt, and sugar

steps.title: Quick-pickle
steps.body: Stir 1/2 cup warm water, the rice vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar, and the salt in the medium bowl until dissolved. Julienne the carrot and daikon and stir them in; they pickle through steps 2-5 (overlap, about 25 minutes).

steps.title: Marinate the tofu
steps.body: Pat the tofu dry and cut it lengthwise into 8 slabs about 1/2 inch thick. Mince the lemongrass and garlic and mix them in the shallow dish with the soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp oil. Turn the slabs in the marinade and leave them 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prep the fillings
steps.body: While the tofu marinates (overlap stated): cut the cucumber into spears, slice the jalapeno, pick the cilantro sprigs, and stir the mayonnaise with the sriracha.

steps.title: Sear the tofu
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in the 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high, about 2 minutes. Lay in the 8 slabs in one layer with any marinade bits and sear until deep golden, about 4 minutes, then turn and sear the second side, about 4 minutes. Move to a plate.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.body: Split the baguettes lengthwise, leaving a hinge. Turn the skillet to medium and toast them cut side down, 2 at a time, about 2 minutes per batch.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Spread the sriracha mayo inside each baguette. Add 2 tofu slabs, a drained handful of pickles, cucumber spears, jalapeno slices, and cilantro sprigs.

Compared with sabich-pita-sandwiches: a lemongrass tofu baguette, not eggplant and egg in pita with tahini.
